'''Galactic grits''' were a type of breakfast [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]<ref name="Dex's" /> that could be eaten by members of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Besalisk" /> They were one of many foods discovered and enjoyed by Besalisk [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] during his life, many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of which he spent traveling around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The dish was served by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> At the diner, which Jettster operated in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the grits were served as a breakfast side that cost 2.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Having "space-y" names for science fiction food is the oldest trick in the book, but if you're working with something as goofy as Dex's, you need to have fun and throw in a few of those.|Gregory Walker on Galactic grits and other foods in his article|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Galactic grits were featured in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="Dex's" /> In his blog, Walker stated that he included food with what he termed "space-y" names to have fun and go along with food names from previous works of science fiction.<ref name="Blog" />
